articles.title: Better sexual mentalizing is linked to better sexual function and more sex over time

articles.title: Scientists analyzed over 3,700 daily reports to see how personal traits and real-world events relate to your dreams

articles.title: LSD may counter some aging-related brain changes, rodent and cell experiments suggest
articles.summary: Scientists first tested whether LSD makes brain cells look younger. That hypothesis failed, yet they found something unexpected: LSD pushed rodent brain genes opposite to human aging and blunted Alzheimer's-related cell damage in lab dishes.

articles.title: Scientists discover a surprising link between weak bones and faster brain aging
articles.summary: Weakening bones may reveal more about brain health than scientists previously realized, with new research linking lower spinal bone density to faster cognitive decline and accelerated changes in the brain's white matter. The surprising connection suggests that routine medical scans could help uncover hidden warning signs of brain aging and identify people at increased risk of dementia.

articles.title: Getting news on gaming platforms like Discord and Twitch is linked to more radical political views

A team led by investigators from the Mass General Brigham Cancer Institute has uncovered additional PIK3CA mutations that allow cancers to become resistant to investigational PI3Kα inhibitors.

articles.title: Massive cell atlas reveals shared patterns across cancer ecosystems
articles.summary: Cancer cells in a tumor often create a unique microenvironment that helps them thrive among normal tissue cells. Alongside the cancerous cells, two other kinds of cells help shape this environment: supportive cells called stromal cells and immune cells. Together, they influence whether a tumor grows, invades nearby tissue or spreads to other parts of the body.
